description: Verify that DUT receives a pure ACK (Length=0, no piggybacking) and stays in ESTABLISHED — must not RST and must continue to honour CLOSE (RFC 793 §3.9)
approach:
[Objective]
A bare ACK (no payload) is normal flow control. DUT must process it without disturbing the connection — no RST, no spurious state change. The case proves the ACK was absorbed cleanly by issuing a CLOSE afterward and observing the FIN.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: 3-way handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: bare ACK (Length=0).
3. Tester → DUT (UT): CLOSE call.
4. Observation: DUT → Tester: FIN (no RST observed)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
No DUT RST after the bare ACK AND DUT emits FIN on CLOSE.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_dut_rst_after_pure_ack — DUT mistakenly emitted RST
• Fail_no_dut_fin — DUT did not emit FIN on CLOSE

verdicts.Pass: DUT absorbed the pure ACK and FIN'd on CLOSE — normal
verdicts.Fail_dut_rst_after_pure_ack: DUT emitted RST after pure ACK
verdicts.Fail_no_dut_fin: No DUT FIN after CLOSE request
